tei:div.tei:p: (373)gsang sgrub rdo rje'i rjong mkhar zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ (374)

dus gsum rgyal ba'i spyi gzugs pad+ma 'byung : skye 'chi bgres rgud bral ba ye shes sku: 'di tsam ma yin tshe rab thams cad du: bdag gi rigs bdag mjod la byin gyis rlobs: de la 'dir bal po bha su dha ra nas brgyud 'i 'jam gling seng chen rgyal po'i sgrub pa la phyi rten sba lcags tshig gsum dar snas brgyan pa: nang rten mda' dar dmar po bya sha zan gsum gyi sgros brgyan pa: gsang rten gser gyi bkre snying gis mtshan pa: bsgrub rten rin chen 'bar ba nor bus mchan pa: mtha' bskor phyi nang gsang mchod phud rgod mang po dang bcas bshams la: oṃ ma hā shu n+ya ta dz+nyā na badz+ra swa bhā wa at+ma ko3haṃ: zhes pas/ chos thams cad stong pa nyid du gyur: stong pa'i ngang las bh+rūm̐ yig 'od zer sna tshogs 'bar ba las 'od zer 'phros pas gnas yul snang ba dang bcas pa thams cad 'og min lha yi gnas ye shes rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa mnan na nem byed pa: btegs (375)na 'phar bar byed pa'i dpag bsam gyi shing dang : bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun 'bab gser gyi bye ma brdal ba: lha yi bya dang ri dwags sna tshogs bde bar brtse ba: rin po che'i sprin sna tshogs 'khrigs pa'i klong nas bdud rtsi'i char sil sil 'bebs pa'i zhing khams chen po'i dbus su rin po che sna tshogs kyi brtsegs 'i pho brang nor bu'i ba gam brjid pa'i rin po che'i tog dang : gdug dang rgyal mtshan ba dan drwa ba dang drwa phyed 'phyang 'phrul sna tshogs pas brgyan pas dbus su yi ge hrīḥdakar po bkrag mdangs dang ldan pa las 'od zer 'phros: rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor ma lus pa mchod: dbang dang byin rlabs thams cad bsdus: yang 'od zer 'phros pas ye shes dang 'jig rten pa'i dregs pa can thams cad la phog thams cad dbang du bsdus: yongs su gyur pa las (376)rin po che ra zab 'bol brtsegs kyi gdan la sku rje skyes bu don 'grub gangs ri'i phung po la nyi ma 'bul gyi 'khyud pa lta bu'i dkar la dmar ba'i mdangs chags pa zhal gcig phyag gnyis rgyal po'i chas gsol ba:

dbu la rmog mo dar 'phru ru dar gyis brgyan pa'i klong na: slob dpon snang srid zil gnon zhi ma khro'i nyams kyis sgeg pa gsal ba: sku la dngul khrab dkar po rin po che'i gser gyi gong rgyan can gsol ba: zhabs la sog l+h+wam 'ja' ris can gsol ba: phyag gnyis sba lcags zhags pa dang bcas pa'i mda' gzhu dgra bgegs la 'gengs ba: zhi ma khro'i nyams cung zad 'bar ba'i mdun du: dgyes sde seng lcam 'brug mo gser g.yu za 'og gis brgyan pa dkar la dmar ba'i mdangs chags pa bu mo bcu drug lon pa'i lang tshos sgeg pa phyag gnyis mda' (377)dar spel ma nam mkhar phyar ba/ g.yon pas rin po che'i gzhong pa nor bu'i bkang ba phyag na bsnams pa'i spyi gtsug tu 'bum khrag mkha' 'gro'i gtso mo mtsho rgyal dmar mo gri gug dang thod pa 'jin pa: gtso bo'i mdun lha yi sde dpan 'bum pa zha dkar bco lnga'i zla ba rgyas pas lta bu'i zhal gcig mche ba'i myu gu cung zad gtsigs pa rmog zhu dar 'phru go khrag dom shams dpal chas dang ldan pa'i phyag gnyis na ral gri dang zhags pa thogs pa: lho ru gnyen gyi sde dpon dpa' rgyal 'dan ma sku mdog mthing nag dmar ba'i mdangs chags pa khro bo'i zhal dang ldan pa rmog zhu dar 'phru go khrab stag shams dpa' chas dang ldan pa'i phyag gnyis mda' gzhu dgra bgegs kyi snying la gzir ba: nub tu klu yi sde dpon (378)seng stag sku mdog me dpung 'bar ba'i rnam pa lta bu zhal gcig phyag gnyis rmog zhu go khrab gzig shams dpa' chas dang ldan pa'i phyag gnyis na mdung dmar klud la bskor ba: byang du bdud kyi sde dpon ber nag can dus mtha'i mun pa'i mdog can zhal gcig phyag gnyis rmog zhu dar 'phru go khrab spyang shams dpa' chas dang ldan pa'i phyag gnyis stobs chen sgyogs rdo dgra bgegs la 'phen pa'o: de rnams kyi phyi rol du dpa' thul rnams dmag mi ge mtshon zhub chas brgyan pa bswo sgra dang bshud sgra sgrogs pa:

de'i phyi rol du srid pa'i lha rab mched dgu: mdur lha bcu gsum sogs rdo rje'i chos skyod ba'i bka' sdod pho nya'i dmag tshogs nam mkha' la sprin 'akrigs pa bzhin gsal bar gyur: lha tshogs de rnams kyi gnas (379)gsum 'od zer 'phros pas rang bzhin sprul pa'i zhing : rnga yab dpal ri pad+ma 'od nas gu ru'i bka' sdod 'jam gling seng chen rgyal po 'khor bcas spyan drangs: badz+ra sa ma ya jaḥ de nas spyan 'dren pa niḥ hūm̐: 'og min rang bzhin sprul pa'i zhing : rnga yab dpal ri pad+ma 'od: sgyu 'phrul sprul pa'i zhing khams nas: rgyal ba'i bka' sdod mthu bo che: ma nges sprul pa'i rdzu 'phrul can: rgyal ba'i bstan srung dregs pa'i gtso: sku rje 'jam gling rgyal po la: lha klu gnyan bdud dgra bla dang : dpa' thul dam can tshogs dang bcas: gnas 'dir spyan 'dren ma thogs byon: snyigs dus 'gro ba bod 'bangs la: thugs bskyed thugs rjes lhag par brtse: sngon gyi dam bcas rgyud bskul na: ma thogs gsang ba'i dam la byon: ma (380)'da' rdo rje'i dbyangs la gson: thugs bskyed thugs rjes de dgongs na: nam mkha' sprin nag bskyed pa bzhin: 'khor dang bcas pa gshegs su gsol: badz+ra sa ma ya ja jaḥ de nas rten la bzhugs pa ni: hūm̐: ma g.yel dgra lha mthu bo che: 'jig rten srid pa'i mnga' bdag rje: 'jam gling rgyal po lcam dral dang : dpa' thul dgra bla'i dmag tshogs rnams: rten la byon zhing brtan par bzhugs: sku mkhar bla rdo sba lcags dang : me long mda' dar gsang ba'i rten: 'khor dang bcas dgyes brtan par bzhugs: bdag la srung skyobs ma zhan mjod: badz+ra sa ma ya s+t+wamaḥ hūm̐: dam tshig can gyi srung ma ni: nam yang mi 'bral 'grogs pa'i phyir: gus dang dad pa'i yid btud de: khyed la phyag 'tshal dngos grub stsol: de nas mchod pa (381) 'bul ba ni: hūm̐: chos skyong chen po 'khor bcas la: phyi yi mchod pa 'bul ba ni:

me tog kha dog mjes pa dang : dri zhim bdug spos sprin ltar gtibs: snang gsal nyi zla'i phreng ba 'khrigs: gtsang ma'i dri chab chu ltar 'bebs: zhal zas bdud rtsi re mchog ldan: sgra dbyangs rol mo'i bye brag rnams: 'bul lo dgra bla'i tshogs la 'bul: dgyes pa chen pos bzhes su gsol: puṣ+pe dhup+pe a lo ke gan+dhe nai wi d+ya shab+ta pra tits+tsha ye swā hā: hūm̐: chos skyong rgyal po 'khor bcas la: nang gi mchod pa 'bul ba ni: dbang po lnga'i me tog dang : tshil chen bdug pa dri gsur dang : dkar dmar nyi zla'i thig le dang : khrag mkhris sbyar ba'i dri chab dang : sha rus zhal zas ja (382)gad phud: rkang gling thod rnga rol mo'i dbyangs: mchod do chos skyong chen po mchod: dgra bla 'khor bcas mnyes par mjod: ma hā pū ja hoḥ hūm̐: chos skyong chen po 'khor bcas la: gsang ba'i mchod pa 'bul ba ni: sgra gcan chos kyi tsakra ru: rol pa dbyings su dag pa las: snang stong sgyu ma dag pa'i gzugs: mi shig nā da gnyug ma'i sgra: 'pho med tshul khrims gtsang ma'i dri: bde stong dga' ba'i zhal zas dang : gsal stong nyams kyi chu rgyun dang : zag med dga' bzhi'i reg bya gos: chos nyid dbyings kyi sgra dbyangs bcas: 'du 'bral med pa'i mchod pa mchog: bde stong dbyings las sprul pa yi: zung 'jug bde chen 'khor bcas la: ro mnyam mchog gi mchod pa 'bul: ma hā rus pa shab+da dhup+pe (383)ni wi d+ya gan+dhe spar+she dharma dha tu ma hā su kha hoḥ hūm̐: dgra bla chen po 'khor bcas la: rak+ta'i mchod pa 'bul ba ni: khams gsum chags pa rak+ta'i rgyun: 'bul lo thugs rjes chags par mjod: ma hā rak+ta la khā hi: skabs 'dir bskang ba 'don mchan/ de nas bstod pa ni/ hūm̐: rgyal ba'i thugs rje las byung ba: ye shes dbyings las sprul pa'i gar: rgyal ba'i bka' nyan dam tshig can: nyams pa'i srog gi gshed ma nyid: dam ldan rnal 'byor skyong ba'i gnyen:

dgra lha chos skyong chen po la: gus pa chen pos phyag 'tshal bstod: zhal mchog thig le nyag gcig 'gyur ba med: phyag gnyis thabs dang shes rab 'du 'bral med: zhabs gnyis srid zhi'i mtha' la rnam mi (384)gnas: ru dar dkar pos dkon mchog dbu 'phang bstod: rmog zhus sangs rgyas bstan pa'i dbu rmog btsan: dngul khrab dkar pos rnal 'byor tshe srog bsrings: tshe gos smug pos dam ldan bu bzhin skyongs: rtags dang yon tan rdzogs pa'i chos skyongs che: yon tan rgya mtshau'i rdul snyed grangs bzhin du: gus pa chen pos phyag 'tshal bstod par bgyi: khyed kyi bka' nyan dgyes sde brtan ma dang : dpa' bo dgra lha dpa' thul wer ma'i tshogs: yang 'khor bod skyongs dkar phyogs dregs pa'i sde: lha glu gnyen dang bdud sde wer ma rnams: gus pas bstod do phrin las 'grub par mjod: de nas bsnyen pa'i rim pa ni: hūm̐: skyes bu chen po'i thugs rin po che mchong gur phub pa lta bu'i zla ba'i gdan gyi steng du yid bzhin gyi nor bu 'od 'bar ba'i dbus su yi (385)ge hrīḥdakar po'i mthar bskor du: oṃ ma da ma nu ṣe pradz+nyā dh+rig seng ha rā ja tsit+ta hrīṃ hrīṃ ja ja sid+dhi pha la hūm̐: zhes pas bskor ba'i phyi rol du yi dam gyi sngags kyi phreng bas btsing bar bsamam pa 'od zer 'phros: 'khor rnams bskul srog gi dwangs ma 'od zer gyi tshul du gtso bo la phul: yang 'od zer 'phros dregs pa can thams cad la phog tshar gcad nus mthu thams cad 'phrog nas thams cad dbang du bsdus par bsam la sngags bzla'o: zhes pa 'di ni ge sar rgyal po lan gsum du dngos su babs nas bskul ba'i rkyen gyis sngags btsun las 'brel gyis bris pa dge'o: ༈ ge sar bskang bsdus chos skyong dgyes pa'i glu zhes bya ba bzhugs: rang nyid skad cig gis pad+ma 'byung gnas gsal ba'i thugs ka'i hrīḥlas 'od dmar glog zhags lta bu 'phros pas rang bzhin sprul pa'i (386)gnas su bzhugs pa'i seng chen 'khor bcasal phog pas sngon gyi dam tshig dran nas/

dgyes pa'i nyams dang*/ snyan pa'i glu dbyangs dang*/ brtse ba'i thugs dang ldan pas byon par bsam/ seng ha rā ja badz+ra sa ma ya ja jaḥ jaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥ na maḥsarba/ sogs lan gsum brjod/ kyai: pad+ma'i bka' nyan rdzu 'phrul can/ smon lam mthu btsan drag rtsal bdag 'jig rten srid pa'i phud bdag che/ seng chen 'khor bcas mnyes pa'i rdzas/ dam rdzas sman gtor rak+ta dang*/ mchod rdzas du ma'i thugs dam bskang*/ 'dod khams phud bdag yin pa'i phyir/ gser skyems g.yu skyems la sogs pa/ bdud rtsi btung ba'i phud mchod kyis/ seng chen 'khor bcas thugs dam bskang : dpa' bo'i dgra bla yin pa'i phyir/ go khrab rmog zhu mdung dar dang*/ dgra chang (387)phud mo la sogs pas/ seng chen 'khor bcas thugs dam bskang*/ srid pa'i nor bdag yin pa'i phyir/ 'dod 'byung yid bzhin nor bu dang*/ gser dngul g.yu dung mgron gyis/ seng chen 'khor bcas thugs dam bskang : bstan dgra'i gshed ma yin pa'i phyir/ gri gug ral gri zhags pa sogs/ thun rdzas rnam pa sna tshogs kyis/ seng chen 'khor bcas thugs dam bskang*/ rgyal bstan srung ma yin pa'i phyir/ rtsa brgyad stong sbyar bdud rtsi dang*/ rak+ta'i khrag skyems dam pa 'dir/ seng chen 'khor bcas thugs dam bskang*/ 'jam gling gzhi bdag yin pa'i phyir/ phye mar 'bru sna sha phud dang*/ 'o zho ja gad btung ba yis/ seng chen 'khor bcas thugs dam bskang*/ (388)khams gsum srog bdag yin pa'i phyir/ snying zhags glo mchin nang rol bcas/ mgo phreng g.yang gzhi la sogs pas/ seng chen 'khor bcas thugs dam bskang*/ srid pa'i 'dod yon sna tshogs dang*/ spyan gzigs dkor cha bla rdo bcas/ mchod rdzas brten rdzas bskang rdzas kyis/ seng chen rgyal po'i thugs dam bskang*/ srog bdag chen po'i thugs dam bskang*/ shan pa'i gtso bo'i thugs dam bskang*/ rnal 'byor srung ma'i thugs dam bskang*/ skyes bu'i dgra bla'i thugs dam bskang*/

dgyes sde seng lcam la sogs pa/ sman phran 'bum gyi thugs dam bskang*/ zhal dkar ber nag can la sogs/ dpa' thul sum bcu'i thugs dam bskang*/ dung skyong dkar po'i thugs dam bskang*/ (390)rgyal bstan dri med bshad sgrub spel/ der 'jin skyes bu'i sdong grogs mjod/ khyad par snga 'gyur bstan pa'i srog 'jig pa'i skyes bu dam pa yi/ mjad phris thugs bzhed gegs med sgrub/ rnal 'byor bdag dang dus nam yang*/ 'bral med las bzhi'i phrin las kyi/ bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mjod/ dge'o/ bkra shis//
